assets.caption: Parties and Tasks/Authorities/Responsibilities

cells.value:
Informs/trains PET.

Facilitates level 3 HFE activities.

Gives advice to Project Manager on planning and status of Project's HFE Implementation Plan.

Participates in model reviews.

Evaluates competences of participants.

Determines and executes HFE during Construction Plan.

Executes HFE audits of designs.

Provides the HFE requirements report (according to quality standards).

Executes HFE in construction approach.

Ensures consistency of ergonomic working methods.

Supports HFE scope definition process with PET.

Includes the necessary process engineering/ project aspects.

Supports Level 3 HFE activities.

Participate in HFE scope identification.

Support HFE activities throughout BDP-Construction.

Contribute Operations/ Maintenance input.

Support decision on approval of HFE recommendations and plan.

Outline in auditable way where HFE activities (and to what level) are required for the project. Led by PM/HFE.

Approves scope of HFE input during construction phase.

Decides on scope changes during Construction.

Assurance of HFE programme.

Carries out all level 2 HFE activities.

Performs reviews on identified work systems.

Ensures competence has been gained before tasks are carried out.

Supports discipline engineers with HFE reviews throughout detailed design.

Reports to Project Manager.

Ensures that competence is at a Working Knowledge level.
